title: When you need to live cleanly
issueStatement: You know what clean living requires, but compromise keeps disguising itself as necessity or sophistication.
centralInsight: Gurbani treats truthful living as trade, conduct, and alignment. False gain does not only stain the action; it fractures the person carrying it.
practicalReflection: Dishonesty is not only lying. It is any deal that leaves the mind more divided than before.
actionPrompt: Refuse one convenient compromise today, even if nobody else would have noticed it.

source.shortMeaning: Buy what goes with you; false deals deform the whole person, while truthful gain becomes fearlessness.
source.lifeApplication: Integrity is an investment, not an accessory.

excerpts.explanation: Guru turns ethics into a question of what actually lasts.

source.shortMeaning: The best religion is tied to pure conduct and the removal of inner dirt.
source.lifeApplication: Right conduct is not separate from devotion.

excerpts.explanation: This keeps conduct from becoming secularized self-improvement.

source.shortMeaning: The true banker is the one trading in Naam as wealth.
source.lifeApplication: Honesty begins with choosing the right economy.

excerpts.explanation: What you count as wealth will shape what you permit yourself to do.
